title: Initial work-tape configuration
statement: For a Boolean input string $y$, a state $s$, an input-head position $ip$ among the $|y|+2$ positions, a natural number $v$, and an integer work-head position $q$, let $K(s,ip,v,q)$ be the configuration with state $s$, input-head position $ip$, empty output, and its single work tape containing the bit representation of $v$ as a buffer, with the work head at $q$.
